description: This Java source file defines the class UserProfileImpl which implements the UserProfile interface. It manages user profile data related to ECU logging, including parameters, switches, and external data, and provides methods for retrieving configuration details, generating XML representations, and checking selections.

classes.name: UserProfileImpl
classes.description: Implementation of UserProfile interface for managing ECU user profiles, including parameters, switches, external data, and related configurations.

methods.name: UserProfileImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing profile data from provided maps and protocol string.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a given LoggerData item is present in the profile.

methods.name: isSelectedOnLiveDataTab
methods.description: Checks if a LoggerData item is selected on the live data tab.

methods.name: isSelectedOnGraphTab
methods.description: Checks if a LoggerData item is selected on the graph tab.

methods.name: isSelectedOnDashTab
methods.description: Checks if a LoggerData item is selected on the dashboard tab.

methods.name: getSelectedConvertor
methods.description: Returns the data converter selected for a given LoggerData item based on user profile.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns the XML representation of the profile as a byte array.

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol string associated with this user profile.

methods.name: buildXml
methods.description: Constructs an XML string representing the user profile configuration.

methods.name: appendLoggerDataElements
methods.description: Helper method to append logger data elements to the XML builder based on profile items.
